name: Geobukseon
description: Turtle Ship (Korean: 거북선 or 귀선) is a large warship used by the Joseon Dynasty to fight against Japanese aggression from the 15th to the 18th century. During the Imjin Patriotic War (also known as the Imjin Japanese Rebellion) from 1592 to 1598, the turtle ship's reputation spread far and wide because it helped the Korean people win several naval battles against Japanese ships. However, contrary to popular belief, the majority of the Korean navy during the war continued to be cabin ships.
